concepts.title: Block phase
concepts.detail: Design a blocky crescent from exactly THREE broad solid horizontal yellow slabs. Their outside right edges describe a bold arcing contour, their inside edges form one chunky stepped recess. The top slab is short, the center widest, bottom slightly shorter. Large clean negative-space gaps between only these three components, no thin banding. A 10-degree rightward lean in the silhouette, but slabs horizontal. Rich golden yellow solid faces with shallow extrusion, black side faces and a crisp pale-yellow edge reflection. Weighty machined-enamel geometric logo, no round full disc underneath. Mostly graphic, sharply memorable.

This is a company mark, with a bold identifiable silhouette readable at 32px. Inspiration is the disciplined geometry and restrained material finish of premium developer apps such as Linear, but invent original Nyte geometry: do not reproduce Linear's diagonal striped circle. concepts.title: Cut arc
concepts.detail: Design one very thick angular amber-yellow arc with a flat diagonal cut through the lower third, leaving exactly TWO snugly related pieces with one confident gap. Outside contour is a rounded octagonal arc rather than a perfect circle; inside contour is smooth, making a strong crescent-shaped geometric company emblem. Blunt precise ends. Flat yellow primary face, subtle bevel and black extrusion, understated industrial finish. Deliberately blocky, clean massing, no repeated stripes, no letterform. Straight-on icon composition with very subtle depth.

concepts.title: Smoked crescent
concepts.detail: Design a single thick SMOKED BLACK GLASS crescent with a luminous YELLOW GLASS inner edge, open to the upper right. The crescent is a solid curved slab, not a bowl, sphere, ring or hole through a ball. Heavy blunt polished ends, a compact nearly circular exterior arc and deep crescent negative space. Most of the mark is obsidian black but broad grey studio reflections make its shape clear against the matte-black tile; a thick rich yellow glass seam runs continuously along its inner curve, with restrained warm refraction and one narrow ivory highlight. A subtle short flat bevel at the lower end gives an ownable geometric detail. Sophisticated tactile icon.

concepts.title: Yellow inlay
concepts.detail: Design a compact glossy-black rounded oblong monolith with a single broad offset curved YELLOW GLASS inlay cut into its right-hand side. The inlay is a clean wedge-shaped crescent tapering to BLUNT ends and its lower tip turns inward as a short square step. The overall mark reads as a simple compact tilted slab with an illuminated yellow cut, not an orb, portal or decorative object. Strong recognizable front-on silhouette, shallow sculptural thickness, outer contour highlighted by a broad soft cool-grey reflection. Black glass and lemon-yellow translucent resin, purposeful bold graphic division; no ring or full-circle motif.

concepts.title: Prism moon
concepts.detail: Design a bold smooth crescent made of TWO interlocking thick curved pieces: a near-black polished glass outer arc and a golden-yellow glass inner arc, slightly offset so their junction creates one short crisp geometric notch near the top. No full circle, no ball, no repeated stripes. A slight rightward tilt. The broad yellow face is the dominant read, with rich transparent edge depth and a controlled bright rectangular studio-light reflection across only its upper third. The black arc anchors the lower left and catches a subtle steel-grey rim. Compact confident company emblem, simple enough to trace as two paths. Premium macOS icon rendering with strong shape clarity.
